login.title: Sign in to Parts Relay
login.description: Continue with Google or get a sign-in link by email.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.description: We sent a sign-in link to {{email}}. It works once and expires in {{minutes}} minutes.

invitation.title: Invitation
invitation.headline: {{inviter}} invited you to join {{workspace}}

join-as.admin: You'll join as {{role}}: you can manage contacts and invite or remove viewers.
join-as.viewer: You'll join as {{role}}: you can follow searches, run your own and see contacts.

sign-in.account: Sign in with the email address the invitation was sent to.

invitation.warning: Joining deletes your current company with its contacts, searches and invitations. This can't be undone.
invitation.setup-pending: Your company isn't set up yet, so accepting simply moves your account to {{workspace}}.

other-account.switch: You're signed in as {{email}}. Sign out, then sign in with the email address the invitation was sent to.

confirm.title: Join {{workspace}}?
confirm.body: Your current company is deleted with its contacts, searches and invitations. Your account moves to {{workspace}} and you can't undo this.

unavailable.title: Invitation not available
unavailable.expired: This invitation has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
unavailable.other-email: This invitation is for another email address.
unavailable.company-not-empty: You belong to a company with other members, so you cannot join another one.
